checks.describe: Home, tabs and footer navigation, draft save and restore, publish confirmed through WP-CLI, start screen, Light/Dark/System, style source, About, logo, subscriber permissions, expired sign-in.
checks.coverageNote: Each assertion cites its requirement document in specs/journeys.spec.ts. Server outcomes are read through WP-CLI on the Studio site.

checks.describe: axe (WCAG 2.0-2.2 A/AA tags) at Home light and dark, the Post composer, the Preferences sheet, About, the expired sign-in banner, a rejected post, and the sign-in screen.
checks.coverageNote: Rule ids and targets per state are attached as axe-<state>.json. An axe pass is not WCAG conformance.

checks.describe: Home in Light, Dark and System (device dark) and the Post composer in Light and Dark, against reviewed baselines in specs/__screenshots__.
checks.coverageNote: Compares only; never writes baselines (updateSnapshots: none).

checks.describe: MSW (@msw/playwright) answers for Micropub posts and the composer config: success, 401, 403, 500, network failure, no answer. Service workers blocked; unhandled requests fail.
checks.coverageNote: Mocked responses show what the UI does with them; they never prove the real backend.

checks.describe: The real service worker: registration and scope, install precache, offline launch, REST never cached, offline queue publishing on reconnect (server-confirmed), update to a new plugin version, manifest install and share-target fields.
checks.coverageNote: No MSW. The update test edits OUTPOST_VERSION in the site's installed copy and restores it; reset.sh reinstalls HEAD regardless.

checks.describe: Bounded Bombadil exploration of /post/ with tests/bombadil/spec.ts properties (draft saved, scroll lock released, one drawer at a time, queue badge label).
